sources.citation: Kraft, Charles H. 1981. Chadic Wordlists, Volume II (Biu-Mandara). Marburger Studien zur Afrika- und Asienkunde A 24. Berlin: Dietrich Reimer. -- 'HIGI (Ghye)' entry (cover page, any 'Notes' page, 434-item tone-marked list).
sources.note: Only first-hand linguistic record of Hya/Ghye; Kraft's per-language 'Notes' pages elsewhere in the volume (Kilba, West Margi) contain incidental stress remarks, so a Ghye notes page, if present, is the one place a stress observation on Hya could exist.
